reused_dismantling_authority.limitations: Use the complete Swiss native reinforcement-steel dismantling service per signed kg of the inspected ecoinvent3.9 cut-off RoW recycling service. Both inventories contain only0.626MJ of building-machine diesel per kg and describe dismantling using skid-steer loaders, with the source itself based on late-1990s Swiss technology. Source waste reference-1kg and native positive treatment reference+1kg require caller factor-1. The native service retains its complete upstream machine/fuel/emission burdens once. This is the source cut-off dismantling boundary, not steel remelting or a zero-inventory recovered-material stock; add no scrap purchase, recovered-steel credit, sorting, collection, density or energy-efficiency multiplier. Caller-signed amounts, uncertainty and formulas remain preserved through the sign change. Native internal lognormal scale0.2653141255310852 differs from source0.2683281572999748; whole-service reuse keeps native internal uncertainty and does not assert equal distributions. Geography, historical machine/fuel/emission/allocation and vintage differences remain screening limitations, with unquantified score effects and the installed UVEK biosphere exclusions. No direct physical elementary exchange is present in either inspected dismantling record; this does not establish zero upstream emissions. Preserve separately supplied caller emissions and all other purchases without adding source fuel a second time. Only this exact3.9cutoff source is admitted for UVEK2026cutoff with ecoinvent3.10biosphere; other releases, collection/sorting services, inverse and cross-model routes remain outside this review.
